title: Reading the Appraisal Register for the Figure a Custody Declaration Rests On
content:
The figure a custody declaration rests on under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes is ordinarily the price the piece originally sold for. Where the Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services register carries a report for the piece, the readings below govern.

## The rule

- Where the appraisal register carries a report for the piece that was issued within the programme's appraisal validity window and that report declares a value for the piece, the declaration rests on the value that report declares.
- Where the register carries such a report but it was issued longer ago than that window, the declaration rests on the highest value the register carries for the piece.
- Otherwise the declaration rests on the price the piece originally sold for.

The report is the register's issued report for the piece; its age is counted in calendar days from the date it was signed to the handling date, and it is within the window while that count does not exceed the window. The value it declares is the declared value recorded on it. The values the register carries for the piece are the valuations recorded against it there, of which the highest is taken.

## The window by programme

| Programme | Appraisal validity window (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 180 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 365 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 365 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 365 |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 180 |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 180 |

## Cases on hypothetical figures

A piece that originally sold for 11000 USD, under a programme whose window is 365 calendar days.

- An issued report 200 days old declaring the piece at 13500 USD: the declaration rests on 13500 USD.
- An issued report 500 days old declaring the piece at 13500 USD, with register valuations of 12800 and 14200 USD: the declaration rests on 14200 USD.
- No report on the register for the piece: the declaration rests on 11000 USD.
